name: @anant/backend
description: Anant Capital backend (Python). This file exists so pnpm can run lint/type-check via shell commands.

scripts.lint: uv run --no-sync ruff check src tests
scripts.type-check: uv run --no-sync mypy --follow-imports=silent src/anant/services/queue src/anant/services/dedupe src/anant/services/claims src/anant/services/evidence src/anant/services/verification src/anant/core/scoring_version.py src/anant/core/ai_circuit_breaker.py src/anant/services/normalization src/anant/services/intake/scheduler.py src/anant/services/intake/sync_runner.py src/anant/services/intake/workspace_cascade.py src/anant/services/intake/admin_router.py src/anant/core/security/secrets.py
